text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober suffered an injury
during training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Gh--...!
...I had no idea it'd hurt this much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, I know I was being stupid.
I overdid it, and I've learned my lesson..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Above all, right now, the regret of not being able
to run for a while is hitting me the hardest...
choice_data_list: Let's take good care of your body for now.
Once you've recovered, let's take it back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Well, I agree with that.
It's not like we can afford to be reckless, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...That's all for our chat. I'll behave, so you can head out now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you worry, I'll rest quietly.
You can go back to work, Trainer.

Mejiro Dober looked in pain as she fought through
her agonizing frustration...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course, that goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Little by little... heal properly
and get back to training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh…… I barely even moved it.
Just when is this going to heal……?"

With the pain showing no sign of fading, Mejiro Dober's
shoulders slumped in deep disappointment...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...I shouldn't look at this as a negative, I have to take it as a positive learning experience...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, since I can't move around, how about you give me a lecture on training instead?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then, once my injury heals,
I'll be able to make up for lost time right away...!

After spending her rest period meaningfully,
Mejiro Dober seems to have found something upon her return!
